articles.title_en: 6 killed, 26 injured in Ukrainian strike on Russian plant in Kirov, governor says
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian strike on a plant in Kirov killed six people and injured 26 others, Kirov Governor Alexander Sokolov said.
